text:
marta: Thanks for joining the all-hands! Dropping a live follow-up thread for travel, hub access, and offsite logistics questions. Keep them short and we'll answer in-thread.

ty: Quick one 11 about travel insurance for international offsites 12: does the company provide coverage or do we need our own?

ella: Ops update: Redwood will provide event travel insurance for sanctioned offsites. For personal side trips, get your own policy. Well post the carrier details in the handbook.

roshan: Visa/process question: if I'm asked to travel to EU for 2 weeks, does ops help with visa letters?

ops-bot: @roshan Yes 12 ops provides invitation/employee letters for visa applications. Submit at least 30 days before departure via https://intra.redwood.com/visas.

sam: For hybrid folks who want to work from another city for a month 12: what counts as "company-sponsored" travel vs "remote work"? trying to sort budget.

ella: Short: company-sponsored = invited to an on-site event or approved client work. Remote work abroad or personal extended travel is not covered by travel budget; check with your manager for exceptions.

kevin: Are there new rules for badge holders using satellite hubs? I had my access revoked after 60 days of inactivity.

rachel: Badge/access rule reminder: recurring hub pass must be requested; inactivity >45 days triggers review. If you need reinstatement, file a hub-pass request and include a brief business reason.

marta: Reimbursements nuance: can teams pre-book conference rooms/hotels for contractors?

ella: Contractors: we can book/cover costs if it's on a PO or approved expense request. Please route through your lead + finance.

ty: Childcare question that came up during Q&A: any temporary childcare subsidy for employees traveling with dependents?

sam: We have a modest dependent-care stipend for mandatory travel for the employee. Submit receipts and a short justification. Not available for optional socials.

roshan: On per diems 11: if local currency fluctuates a lot, can we get an advance to avoid rate loss?

ops-bot: Advances available. Use Travel Request form and select "advance". We recommend specifying currency and estimated amount. Finance will reconcile final exchange on expense closeout.

kevin: Coworking space reimbursement: daily cap? monthly cap? examples appreciated.

rachel: We reimburse reasonable coworking fees for company-sponsored travel. Examples: $25/day for a casual day, $200/week for dedicated workspace while on an approved working trip. We'll add a short examples table in the handbook.

marta: Any pro tips for booking cheaper flights for offsites?

ella: Ops tip: book 140-7 days out where possible, use approved vendor portal, and request flexible fares only if schedule is uncertain. Ops can help with group bookings; DM with dates.

ty: Request: can we get a one-page checklist for managers running small offsites (travel, lodging, per-diems, visa, insurance)?

marta: Yes. We'll publish a manager's offsite checklist + vendor list by next Wednesday and drop it here. Thanks all, keep questions short and add them below. :sparkles:
